description: This file defines the base activity class for an Android application, handling common setup such as logging initialization. It extends FragmentActivity and includes logging setup in onStart.

classes.name: SampleActivityBase
classes.description: A base class for activities that provides common logging setup and lifecycle handling for Android sample activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is created. Currently calls the superclass implementation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity becomes visible. Calls initializeLogging().

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism by creating a LogWrapper and attaching it to the Log chain, then logs a 'Ready' message.
